instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: In an evening high school classroom, after work, I take out my notebook, I check if I have any work messages on my phone. I want to avoid using it in class. Still, I can't say I will stay away from messages, whatever happens. As an adult, I want to take responsibility for both my work and studies. In my notebook's margin, I write what I want to tell the school. Before it is decided to lock devices away, I want room to think about it, too. I don't want to put my responsibility for managing my own device use into the back.
